label: Q-25
title: Post-cutover the third-party 37.1% Balancer remainder stays a live second venue at the same price: part of the Stage-4 peg lift is arbitraged into it ($8-$11 at current depth; V2 settles ~$0.9735 not $1)
description:
After the cutover, the external EOA's 37.1% stays on Balancer as a live second venue: 11,007 sUSDS and 13,249 phUSD, at the same price. It remains swappable until Balancer swaps stop or the LP exits. Any price lift on the V2 pair is partly arbitraged into that remainder. Figures below are from a closed-form constant-product model (ECON-004, confidence medium) on fork-state inputs; they were not fork-executed. Constant-product, 0.3% fees both venues:
- Zap Δ* = 1,540 sUSDS (V2 to $1.000): the arbitrage moves 259.5 sUSDS through and nets 9.68 sUSDS ($11). V2 settles at $0.9735 and Balancer at $0.9678.
- Counterfactual, off the story-103 path: stray 1,308.1 sUSDS (the old pooler's idle sUSDS), had it been routed through the escrow before exitAndSeed instead of rescueERC20 -> UniPoolerV2 as story-103 step 9 specifies: the seed price becomes $0.9885 and the arbitrage nets 6.84 sUSDS ($8).
Donor strays sent to the escrow are seeded as 100% POL at the donor's cost (the profile's claim is confirmed).
impact: Opportunity cost only. After the cutover, the third party's 37.1% Balancer remainder (11,007 sUSDS / 13,249 phUSD) stays a live second venue at the same price, so part of a Stage-4 peg lift is arbitraged into it: about $11 at Δ*=1,540 sUSDS, with V2 settling at $0.9735 instead of $1, or about $8 in a counterfactual stray-sUSDS variant that is off the story-103 path (step 9 routes that sUSDS via rescueERC20 -> UniPoolerV2). Figures are closed-form (ECON-004), not fork-executed.
failureScenario: Ordinary arbitrage after the cutover: a Stage-4 zap lifts the V2 pair toward $1; arbitrageurs move ~259.5 sUSDS through the 37.1% Balancer remainder, netting ~9.68 sUSDS ($11); V2 settles at $0.9735.
assumptions: Balancer swaps on the remainder stay enabled after the cutover.
evidence: ECON-004 closed-form constant-product model on fork-state inputs (block 26136000); confidence medium
